sloka: निवातकवचास्तत्र दैत्या लब्धवरा वसन् ।राक्षसान्तान्समागम्य युद्धाय समुपाह्वयत् ।। ७.२३.६ ॥
transliteration: nivātakavacāstatra daityā labdhavarā vasan ।rākṣasāntānsamāgamya yuddhāya samupāhvayat ।। 7.23.6 ॥

translations.english: There lived the Nivātakavachas, Daityas who had obtained boons, and Ravana, having approached them, challenged them to battle.
